gold.text: Users can edit existing property listings.
Users can create and manage property listings.
Users can search for existing housing information by entering a text field.
Travelers can fill out a booking application form (selecting dates, residents, contact information, etc.)
The homeowner can refuse or approve a booking request.
Users cannot perform a search without entering any content.
Users cannot submit listings with empty required fields (location, description, amenities, photos (image links), and nightly price).
The check-in date submitted by the traveler must be when the property is available for rent; dates that are already booked or are inappropriately dated cannot be selected.
Only one valid booking can be accepted for the same property at the same time.
Homeowners can only manage the listings they create and their corresponding booking requests; they cannot manage other people's listings.
Travelers can only submit booking requests and do not have access to edit property listings.
Page updates after users filter by price range, number of guests, and property type.
After submitting a simple booking request form and selecting check-in dates, users will receive visual confirmation (a success message or notification).

In the available rental date calendar, booked dates are grayed out and cannot be selected. Selected check-in/check-out dates will automatically calculate the booking duration and estimated total amount, which will be displayed to the user in real time.
Travelers can submit reviews after booking, including ratings and written comments. Reviews will be displayed on the property details page. Repeated reviews of the same property are not allowed.
After clicking on a property listing, users can view detailed information about the property (basic reviews, item details).
